name: Pod Bubble
summary: A story player that folds into a floating bubble as you scroll, which you throw, open or drop in the bin
about: A phone article with a listen-to-this-story player at the top. Start it and keep reading: as the card scrolls away its cover flies out and becomes a round bubble with a live progress ring, docked to the edge. Throw the bubble to either side and it springs and squashes against the wall, tap it for a pill of controls, or drag it onto the X that rises from the bottom to close the player.
how: Press play on the story card, then scroll the article: the player folds into a bubble on the right edge.
Drag the bubble anywhere and let go; it flies to the nearest side with a spring and a squash.
Tap the bubble for play, back 15 s, forward 15 s and close; tap anywhere else to fold the pill away.
Drag the bubble down onto the X to close the player, or scroll back to the top and it flies home into the card.
Keyboard: Enter on the bubble opens the controls, arrow keys move it, Delete closes it; the waveform is a slider.
